11:     oscillator.frequency.value = freq;
12:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
13:     oscillator.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     oscillator.start();
18:     setTimeout(() => {
19:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
20:       oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
21:     }, duration);
22:   };
